cim: Artificial intelligence for antibiotic discovery and design
cim_eredeti: Artificial intelligence for antibiotic discovery and design
szoveg_eredeti:
Antibiotic-resistant bacterial infections cause more than 1 million deaths worldwide each year. To effectively address this escalating global health crisis, there is a critical need for new classes of antibiotics, particularly those with novel mechanisms of action. In this Review, we focus on recent advances in small-molecule antibiotic discovery enabled by artificial intelligence. We present a range of innovative approaches that are substantially increasing the size and diversity of the explored chemical space. We highlight recent artificial intelligence-driven advancements in phenotypic antibiotic discovery, mechanism of action elucidation, target-based discovery, de novo molecular design and lead optimization, which promise to expand the repertoire of antibacterial agents and uncover bacterial pathways and vulnerabilities amenable to therapeutic intervention.
